systems.name: Instance registry (instance_list)
systems.note: Salvage I rows live in Topaz (ids 62, 65, 68, 71). Salvage II rows (64, 67, 70, 73) are commented placeholders; ids 63/66/69/72 are held spare. Source: sql/instance_list.sql, docs/project-memory/18-instance-id-master-list.md. DSP: Salvage I rows 62/65/68/71 are shipped by the salvage-<zone>-v2 slices (merged to valhalla main 2026-10-09, base slice salvage-base-v1).

systems.name: Pathos restrictions
systems.note: Silver Sea instance applies ENCUMBRANCE_I, OBLIVISCENCE, OMERTA, IMPAIRMENT, DEBILITATION on entry and removal rules are per-zone. Whether the full retail Pathos list and cell items are built is unverified.

systems.name: Floor / stage progression
systems.note: Zhayolm and Arrapago/Bhaflau instance files model stages and door unsealing. Silver Sea ports only entry, failure and exit; LSB has no stage or door progression for it and none was invented. DSP ports keep the same limits: Bhaflau Empathic_Flan is not ported (DSP has no TAKE_DAMAGE event), so its Dormant_Rampart reveal is only partly functional.

systems.name: Doors and telepads
systems.note: Door npcs exist per zone (Zhayolm _210.., Arrapago _220.., Bhaflau _230.., Silver Sea none). Telepad csids are derived per zone and must come from captured events.

systems.name: Slot / Socket / Armoury Crate
systems.note: Slot, Socket and Armoury_Crate npc scripts exist in all four zones. Per-zone local values differ, so they cannot be centralised.

systems.name: Mob and NM roster
systems.note: Mob scripts counted from the live tree. Spawn points, pools and drop lists are not verified against captures. DSP slices carry mob_groups/spawn points/instance_entities per zone; every live spawn row, group, pool and droplist is carried, including pool-0 groups and (0,0,0) placeholder mobs (the loader skips those until they are positioned or given a pool).

systems.name: Completion and extraction
systems.note: Instance completion/failure hooks are listed per track. How retail extraction and the post-run reward flow work is not yet captured.

systems.name: Salvage II (_ii variants)
systems.note: No server content. Capture 228 (Silver Sea Remnants, Salvage II) has 124 NPC entries in-zone plus events from Gilded Doors (0x012C), Gilded Gateway (0x019A), Runic Lamp (0x01F4), Runic Portal (0x0075), Damisha, Zasshal, Sharin-Garin and Mrohk Sahjuuli. Meanings are not decoded yet.
needs: decode the event ids with explore_event.py

systems.name: DSP port (valhalla main)
systems.note: Merged 2026-10-09: salvage-base (salvage.lua, gears/rampart mixins, C++ dependency manifest + verify_base.py) and salvage-zhayolm/silversea/bhaflau/arrapago v2, each independent on the base. Untested in-game. Not ported: Topaz weapon_break/qutrub mixins (no CRITICAL_TAKE event), Empathic_Flan (no TAKE_DAMAGE), Archaic_Gear is melee-only (ATTACKED).
needs: decision on adding CRITICAL_TAKE/TAKE_DAMAGE/COMBAT_TICK engine events

npcs.name: Mrohk Sahjuuli
npcs.note: Capture 228: entity 16982637 at (23, 0, -88) in Whitegate. 45 event packets with him: event 0x03C9 (1 incoming, option 2 outgoing) and 0x03CD (9 incoming, option 0 each). What the menus do is not decoded; role unverified.
